events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

You're talking to an AI assistant for the Halcyon Components IT service desk, not a person. I don't know which underlying AI model powers me.

I can reset employee passwords and look up support tickets. If you'd prefer to speak with a person, the service desk is at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm.

If you'd like to continue here, please provide your employee ID. The reset link will be sent to the phone registered on your account.
